title: Implementation
summary: Implement an approved delivery scope: a milestone, Change Request, Bug Fix Spec, or Work Scope Brief. PRD, Design Spec, ticket, or branch evidence is normalized into a bounded Work Scope Brief before code changes. Continue here when a work item is ready to build. Launch with empty inputs to discover open work. Gates delivery verification on Review & Verification, then records the result with Delivery Sync & Spec Update. Leaves changes in the working tree.
